KFAC.description: Effective Length Factor (KFAC). Effective length factors applied about the member's major (Ky), minor (Kz), and torsional (Kt) axes for design.

Ky.description: Effective length factor about the major (y) axis.

Kz.description: Effective length factor about the minor (z) axis.

Kt.description: Effective length factor for torsional buckling.
